questions.query: What is secureWISE?
questions.actual:
secureWISE is a remote equipment monitoring and access system designed to provide greater visibility into equipment uptime and utilization to improve health and functionality . It is architected to deliver secure, end-to-end remote connectivity to equipment over private networks to provide operator visibility into data to drive predictive analytics . Developed in the early 2000s, secureWISE was designed specifically to manage supplier remote connectivity for the semiconductor industry and was built to address the needs of both equipment suppliers and semiconductor manufacturing facilities . It functions on a “single pane of glass” concept, meaning that potentially dozens of separate connections from different equipment suppliers are replaced with just one connection through secureWISE . The secureWISE system consists of proprietary software, dedicated hardware, and a managed network . Its components include: secureWISE Software (modules that are on-equipment, SaaS, and on-premise on servers, including the secureWISE Business Management Portal (BMP) software which provides customer-specific dashboards with views of authorized user activity) ; secureWISE Servers (server-side software deployed at each manufacturing facility, acting as a triple-A (authentication, authorization, and audit) server, with antivirus protection that scans file transfers and quarantines malicious files) ; and secureWISE Network (a self-managed global private network connecting equipment suppliers and fabs through strategically positioned hubs, operating primarily through IPsec VPN tunnels, with layered dual-encryption protection: IPsec at the network level and TLS (HTTPS) between endpoints) . As of December 31, 2025, the secureWISE network connected over 300 manufacturing locations and over 100 equipment OEMs, managed the exchange of terabytes of data with reliable uptime across eight regions, and is within the scope of an information security management system that is ISO 27001:2022 certified . The secureWISE system is present in virtually every 300-millimeter factory in the world .
